items.title: Coinbase's national trust charter approval is a major win for crypto custody
items.summary: A top financial regulatory cop has granted Coinbase — the world's biggest crypto exchange — a national trust charter.

items.title: Coinbase, Kalshi, and Kraken are lawyering up. Here's why.
items.summary: Scott Melker outlines the latest update on the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission's (CFTC's) legal fight over perpetual futures, highlighting why Coinbase (COIN), Kalshi (KLSH.PVT), and Kraken (KRAK.PVT) are getting involved.

items.title: 7.1 Million Bitcoin Sit in Wallets a Quantum Computer Could One Day Crack. Is Yours One of Them?
items.summary: A third of all Bitcoin has a public key sitting in plain view, yet the real pressure on price is coming from somewhere else entirely. Find out which coins count as exposed and what one cheap transaction could change.

items.title: Coinbase Gets National Bank Charter Approval
items.summary: Bloomberg's Olga Kharif joins Isabelle Lee and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." Coinbase, the largest US crypto exchange, said a key regulator has fully signed off on its request to become a nationally chartered trust bank, the latest example of firms in the digital-asset space entering the world of traditional finance.

items.title: Securitize Stock Jumps 24%, Defying Crypto Slump. Its Tokenized Assets Hit $5 Billion.
items.summary: Securitize stock is heading for its best single-day percentage gain on record even after reporting mixed earnings.

items.title: Coinbase Falls 4%, Robinhood Slides 3% as Hot Inflation Data Drags Bitcoin Lower; Webull Declines 2%
items.summary: A hotter-than-expected CPI print has traders betting on a December Fed rate hike, and crypto-linked stocks are feeling it unevenly. Which one is bleeding most, and what separates Coinbase from its peers when rate fears spike?

items.title: Sen. Warren targets Trump family crypto firms, and miner MARA sold BTC for $1.1 B
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses bitcoin miner MARA selling 13K+ BTC (BTC-USD) for $1.1 billion, with plans to sell more;  Senator Elizabeth Warren tells Trump family crypto firms to save their receipts, and the NYSE taps Avalanche to figure out its planned tokenized stock platform. 

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.
